beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Dave lays three cards face down. "Let's see the whole shape of this, not just today's."

beats.prompt: The past: the decision that put the two of you in business together.
The present: the shop, and everything you've actually built there.
The future: what you're standing in front of right now.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay, quiz me on this one then. If I already have what I need, why did it take me a week to even start?"

options.text: Having the resources isn't the same as trusting them yet.
You didn't actually have what you needed after all.
A week means the card was wrong.

elaboration: The Magician points at what's already on the table — it doesn't promise you'll reach for it right away.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And the communication part — I haven't said a word to the client yet."

options.text: It's still there when the moment actually calls for it.
The Magician isn't about talking to clients.

elaboration: A gift for communication is worth nothing sitting unused — the right words at the right moment is still the deal, whenever that moment turns out to be.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the choice that started this, the thing you've since built, and the skill you're only now willing to use."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think I've been treating 'ready' like a feeling I'm supposed to wait for, instead of just picking up the tools already in front of me. That actually helps."
